title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Cancellation Fee Basis by Booked Rental Days
content:
**Schedule note — the cancellation fee basis of a late-cancelled Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation.** The cancellation fee basis is the amount the late cancellation fee of a reservation is figured on. It depends on the rental days booked, counted as the calendar days from the scheduled pickup date to the scheduled return date (dates only, the times left aside):

- a reservation booked for **3** or more days is charged **2** times the class rental fee for one period (the class base rate);
- a reservation booked for two days is charged the larger of one class base rate and the flat late cancellation fee figure of the class;
- any other reservation is charged the flat late cancellation fee figure of the class.

## Branch table

| Rental days booked | Cancellation fee basis |
|---|---|
| 0 (return scheduled on the pickup date) | Flat late cancellation fee figure |
| 1 | Flat late cancellation fee figure |
| 2 | The larger of one class base rate and the flat late cancellation fee figure |
| 3 | 2 times the class base rate |
| 4 or more | 2 times the class base rate |

## Worked bases (hypothetical reservations; class figures from the rate card and the cancellation fee table)

| Reservation | Rental days booked | Cancellation fee basis (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck, pickup 4 May, return 6 May | 2 | 29.95 — larger of 29.95 and 25.00 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck, pickup 4 May, return 6 May | 2 | 50.00 — larger of 39.95 and 50.00 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck, pickup 4 May, return 7 May | 3 | 59.90 — 2 times 29.95 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck, pickup 4 May 18:00, return 5 May 09:00 | 1 | 25.00 |
